value.expansion_review: Public residues and content-free errors have ordinary Debug. All secret wrappers delegate to secrecy redaction, and DependencyIds has a constant redacting Debug itself. The raw list is released only after an explicit matching check. Equality preserves authored pairs exactly. No derived encoder is introduced.
